claims.text: The Jasper architecture serves as a good baseline approach for exploring more sophisticated techniques in language modeling.
The Hub5 Year 2000 evaluation is a widely used baseline in academia for evaluating language models.
The evaluation dataset is divided into two subsets: Switchboard and Callhome, which are used as baselines.
